name: Jester’s Tricks
body:
School divination; Level: jester 4

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Select one skill in which you do not have ranks. You gain ranks in that skill until the end of your next turn equal to your level.
